jub.dates: † 18-го сентября 1894 г.; b. 24 April 1829; in service from 21 March 1848 (seniority 26 April 1845); 50-year jubilee planned for spring 1895
jub.evidence_verbatim: онъ сразу занялъ амплуа 1-го танцовщика на комическія роли, которое и несъ съ успѣхомъ въ теченіе всей своей полувѣковой службы
jub.evidence_english: At once took the line of first dancer in comic roles and held it throughout his half-century of service.
jub.notes: Key ballet entry. Last appeared 18 Sept 1894 at the Mikhailovsky Theatre in «Коппелія»; taken ill in the interval after act 2 and died in his dressing room of heart failure. Roles named: Донъ-Кихотъ, Пьеръ-Гренгуаръ («Эсмеральда»), Джонъ-Буль («Дочь фараона»), Тарасъ («Золотая рыбка»), Маркобомба. Sent to Moscow end of 1851. Taught dancing 40+ years at Smolny, Ekaterininsky, Patriotic and Elizavetinsky institutes and the Alexandrovsky Lyceum. Married to a daughter of the ballet artist Н. О. Гольцъ. Born in the village of Козьмино, Ardatov uezd, Simbirsk gub.

jub.role: dancer / mime, honoured artist, St Petersburg
jub.evidence_verbatim: Четвертое представленіе (5-го февраля) «Лебединаго озера» было дано въ пользу вдовы и сиротъ умершаго въ обозрѣваемомъ сезонѣ (18-го сентября 1894 года) заслуженнаго артиста Т. А. Стуколкина.
jub.evidence_english: The 4th performance of Swan Lake (5 February) was given for the benefit of the widow and orphans of the honoured artist T. A. Stukolkin, who died this season (18 September 1894).

tnotes.research_reading: two periods (possibly continuous); leaving date conflict 1901/1902
tnotes.discrepancy: DATE CONFLICT: 1901-02 p.77 no. 127 prints «Оставила службу 1 января 1902 г.», 1902-03 p.72 no. 120 prints «Оставила службу 1 января 1901 г.» (both zoomed). She is listed in both of those volumes and again in 1903-04 (37 performances); absent from 1904-05, where «Федорова 2-я» is Александра Александровна (съ 1 іюня 1902 г.); back 1905-06..1907-08 (17, 57, 54 performances), same start «съ 12 мая 1885 г.», no return note. She may never have left: the gap is one season, after which she returns under her old ordinal and start.
tnotes.corroboration_found: none usable: review mentions of «Федорова 2-я» in 1903-04/1904-05 may be Александра Александровна | Season Reviews (SP) name «Ѳедорова 2-я» -- the roster ordinal held by Лидія in those seasons -- in group dances: 1903-04 x3 (pas des concurrentes; Danse des papillons; Pas des Batelières), 1905-06 x1 (Danse «Grossvater»), 1906-07 x4 (подруги Изабеллы, Вакханки, Тарантелла, Грезы); none in 1904-05 (2-я that year = Александра Александровна). Added 2026-11-02 (person field audit; review text as stored, not re-read on the scans); RG kept the 19 Oct reading.
